coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:dfb3fbd9-4.title: Logistics Manager
coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:dfb3fbd9-4.description: Responsibilities: Lead Global Transportation Strategy Execution: Direct the team in implementing global international transportation strategies to ensure efficient and cost-effective logistics operations. Freight Forwarder & supplier Collaboration: Oversee collaboration with global contracted freight forwarders, including obtaining quotes, negotiating rates, comparing international freight costs, selecting optimal routes, and planning shipment schedules. Guide the team in working closely with local vendors to confirm delivery requirements and schedules prior to cargo loading, ensuring smooth operations. Monitor Transportation Performance: Monitor the preparation and submission of accurate commercial documents to China import & export, and global customs authorities within specified timeframes to ensure seamless cargo clearance. Lead the team on vessel booking, manage on-site cargo loading, and oversee transportation processes to ensure timely departures and proper handling of shipments. Standardized Shipping Process Implementation: Develop and implement standardized processes for tracking shipments, documenting shipping activities (e.g., global market documentation, loading photos), and ensuring all global shipments are traceable through a unified system. Team Leadership and Alignment:Collaborate with the direct report to align team responsibilities, provide motivation, and ensure goals are achieved accurately and efficiently. Requirement: 10+years working experience in international trade, transportation, customs declaration. Relevant working experience and familiar with document review, booking of shipping space, commodity inspection, customs declaration, and contact with freight forwarding, customs brokerage, freight forwarding warehouse and other links. Computer skills, serious and responsible work, high initiative, strong learning ability, good at communication, thinking and solving problems; Good at time management, able to work under pressure, hard-working.

envisionrpo-envisionrpo:lever:74d579e6-1.title: Recruiting Specialist
envisionrpo-envisionrpo:lever:74d579e6-1.description: Would you like to be a central part of a recruiting team that is responsible for fueling the rapid growth of Envision? Are you a self-starter with the drive to make impactful contributions to a high-growth company? Do you thrive in an environment where your success is recognized, and flexibility and respect are commonplace? Envision is seeking an open-minded, driven recruiting specialist to identify and hire great talent for our top recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) clients. You will work to understand our clients' recruitment processes from top to bottom and use data to draw insights and craft effective hiring strategies to fill in the missing pieces, making their hiring process smarter and more efficient--not just for today, but also for tomorrow.
responsibilities: Collaborate with an experienced team of talent acquisition professionals to identify and implement effective recruiting strategies that address clients' immediate and long-term needs
Execute all phases of the recruitment process from candidate sourcing to offer signing
Create and maintain strong pipelines of both active and passive candidates from various industries and markets using multi-channel strategies
Conduct thorough candidate interviews to assess and identify top talent
Communicate with both candidates and clients in a timely, professional, and genuine manner
Identify and communicate improvement opportunities and strategies to client stakeholders

farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:ca4ed7ed-51.title: Customer Service Advisor - FPS (English Speaker - Rotating Shifts)
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:ca4ed7ed-51.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. OPERATIONS We're passionate about operational excellence, acting with our customers and partners always in our heart. Covering the entire order journey, we create our online content, secure payments and fraud process compliance, ensure order fulfilment and delivery, while providing customer and partner care. In a nutshell, we love to create seamless and memorable luxury experiences for our customers all around the world. LISBON Our Lisbon office provides a dynamic workspace, surrounded by the city's top cafés, restaurants, and stunning riverfront views. It seamlessly blends innovation with the capital's cosmopolitan and creative energy. THE ROLE As a Customer Service Advisor, you are the face and voice of Farfetch Platform Solutions, our strategic partners and a key team member who loves and understands customers, keeping them front of mind. Exceeds their expectations by providing exceptional service through the quality, speed and efficiency of your support and delivering an unforgettable experience while helping them discover our partner’s amazing products selection. Reporting to the Customer Service Supervisor, you will gain excellent hands-on experience in a fast-paced fashion environment.
responsibilities: Be the first point of contact, providing an optimum level of service to all of our customers, resolving their queries and requests across multiple channels (email, phone, and chat) within our customer promise;
Be the face of Farfetch Platform Solutions to our customers and partners alike;
Provide information and best advisory with regards to products and services and other related inquiries;
Take ownership of case resolution, finding the best solutions according to the company’s process and guidelines;
Manage demanding customers with professionalism and emotional intelligence focusing on solution and retention;
Advocate on your customer's needs working with other internal teams, namely by identifying and boosting localization initiatives;
Managing your own development and supporting others to maximize team potential;
Actively contribute to a great work environment and the alignment with Farfetch and strategic partners' values in the team.

You’ll work closely with clients to understand their businesses, challenges, and strategic priorities in depth. As a key link between business stakeholders and technical teams, you’ll translate complex requirements into clear and practical solutions. The position provides significant exposure to diverse business topics, allowing you to build deep expertise across different client environments. You’ll contribute to solving meaningful business problems while helping turn digital strategies into tangible outcomes. With an entrepreneurial mindset and increasing responsibility, you’ll have room to shape both client engagements and your own professional growth. Analyze business needs and work closely with clients to identify, structure, and document system and technology requirements. Translate business requirements and complex technical concepts into clear, understandable information for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Serve as a bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring requirements, priorities, and proposed solutions remain aligned. Entrepreneurial mindset with an interest in taking ownership and progressively assuming greater responsibility. Opportunity to combine technology consulting with strategic business advisory in a dynamic environment. Hardware budget allowing you to select equipment according to your individual needs. Company-provided iPhone with a mobile contract, including private use. jobgether-jobgether:lever:43f0796c-4655-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr UI/UX Designer based in India. As a Sr UI/UX Designer, you will shape intuitive, engaging digital experiences for products serving the iGaming industry. You will own key aspects of the design process, from user research and concept development to prototyping, testing, and refinement. The role combines creative thinking with data-driven decision-making to deliver experiences that are both visually compelling and highly usable. You will work closely with product and development teams to transform business requirements into effective digital solutions. Your expertise will help improve customer journeys, strengthen product experiences, and support innovative design initiatives. This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving environment while continuously expanding your UI/UX expertise. Design intuitive, engaging, and user-centered interfaces that align with client brand identities and product objectives within the iGaming sector. Research user behaviors, preferences, and needs to inform design decisions and create meaningful user experiences. Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional and visually compelling designs. Develop wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and other design deliverables to communicate concepts effectively and support product development. Conduct usability testing, gather user and stakeholder feedback, and continuously iterate on designs to improve usability and overall experience. Apply data-driven insights from analytics, experimentation, and user research to identify opportunities for product and UX improvements. Monitor emerging UI/UX trends, design practices, technologies, and developments across the iGaming industry to introduce innovative solutions. Requirements Degree or equivalent academic background in IT, UI/UX Design, or a related discipline is preferred. At least 3 years of professional experience in UI/UX design, with a strong understanding of UX principles and user-centered design methodologies. Demonstrated experience designing digital products for the iGaming industry, with an in-depth understanding of its users and product environment. Strong proficiency with design and collaboration tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, and Miro, as well as prototyping tools such as Origami Studio, Noodl, Framer, Proto.io, or UXPin. Experience applying data-driven design practices using tools and methods such as Google Analytics, A/B testing, and Hotjar. Experience conducting and interpreting both qualitative and quantitative user research. Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud tools, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects. Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how design decisions translate into digital interfaces. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders at different levels. Creative, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail and a consistent ability to meet deadlines. Willingness to learn, experiment with new approaches, and continuously develop UI/UX knowledge and capabilities. Professional working proficiency in English. Benefits Competitive salary. Flexible opportunity to work remotely from anywhere. Supportive and collaborative working environment that encourages creativity and inclusion. Career growth and professional development opportunities. Friendly and supportive colleagues. Corporate events and team activities. Comprehensive benefits package. Opportunity to contribute to innovative digital products within the iGaming industry. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8846904a-5b7d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Localization Specialist based in Canada. This role supports the delivery of high-quality multilingual content across digital learning products and services. You will coordinate localization projects from requirements gathering through delivery, ensuring timelines, quality, and stakeholder expectations are met. The position combines project management, technical writing, localization operations, and customer-focused problem solving. You will work closely with internal teams, external partners, vendors, and subject matter experts to identify and resolve localization challenges. The role also offers opportunities to use AI-assisted tools to improve translation quality, content workflows, and operational efficiency. You will contribute to scalable processes, documentation, and quality programs that improve the experience for customers and learners worldwide. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, technology-focused environment where continuous learning and innovation are strongly encouraged. Manage localization projects and course package translation requests from initial requirements gathering through successful delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time and within budget. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to identify localization gaps, troubleshoot translation issues, determine root causes, and implement effective solutions. Coordinate with vendors and partners to manage localization deliverables, timelines, quality expectations, and ongoing relationships. Develop, conduct, and track translation quality programs while monitoring localization issue trends and time-to-resolution metrics. Analyze localization workflows and content localizability to identify opportunities for process improvements and more efficient solutions. Create, maintain, and refine standard operating procedures, FAQs, blog posts, known-issue and fixed-issue documentation, and other external-facing content. Monitor publishing queues and review, edit, and publish content and media in accordance with established technical writing standards. Gather and analyze localization requirements in collaboration with requestors and subject matter experts. Use data tracking tools to produce actionable insights that support localization performance and operational decisions. Support high-priority localization initiatives and additional projects as business needs evolve. Leverage AI-assisted authoring, summarization, translation, and quality-assurance tools responsibly, validating outputs for accuracy, consistency, and compliance with AI governance standards. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience, with approximately 2–3 years of relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a four-year degree. Professional experience managing human or machine translation and post-editing projects. Fluency in English and at least one additional language, such as Canadian French, Mexican Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, or Arabic. Experience with Translation Management Software and familiarity with content management and learning management systems. Working knowledge of GitHub and version-control practices. Familiarity with technical content and web technologies, including JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Excellent written communication and technical writing skills, with an ability to create clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate documentation. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with confidence working across internal teams, external vendors, and subject matter experts. titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:06d6e730-0379.description: About Titan Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 400+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. About the Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own client engagements end to end, operating at the intersection of IT operations and the Titan AI platform. You bring clients onto Titan: learning their environment, mapping their systems, encoding their policies, and standing up the engagement. From there you're their single point of contact through onboarding and strategic projects, driving both the relationship and the technical work. This role is focused on serving our enterprise clients. What You'll Do - Own customer engagements end to end: design and deliver implementations that align Titan to each customer's workflows and goals. - Build AI agents: design and build agents on Titan's platform that drive real value for customers. - Lead migrations: design and execute migration plans that minimize disruption and ensure seamless adoption of Titan's platform. - Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to turn field learnings into repeatable processes and a sharper go-to-market. Who You Are - 3+ years in a deployed, field, or solutions-engineering role - A natural owner. You run the relationship and the timeline without being told to, and clients trust you in the room. - Comfortable with ambiguity and speed. You'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. - Technical depth to work hands-on: proficient with scripting and APIs, with the aptitude to learn identity, cloud, and security/endpoint tooling. - Fluent alongside AI tools, and able to help design AI-native workflows and tooling. - Bonus: hands-on experience in the infosec sector - Bonus: Experience dealing with Enterprise customers
